Reference

Configuration reference

Manage the settings you care about. Leave everything else in your normal Ghostty configuration.

Know your files#

File or directoryPurpose
config.tomlSource definitions and schema version.
profiles/*.tomlYour editable visual recipes.
current.ghosttyGenerated managed configuration; do not edit directly.
history/activations/Durable activation history; preserve it.
assets/sha256/Saved image assets; preserve them.
cache/Disposable cache.

Terminal settings#

Profile · terminal
[terminal]
font_size = 13.5
background_opacity = 0.92
background_blur_intensity = 20
cursor_style = "bar"
PropertyAccepted values
font_size1–1000, up to 3 decimal places.
background_opacity0–1, up to 6 decimal places.
background_blur_intensityInteger from 0–255.
cursor_styleblock, bar, underline, block_hollow.

An empty [terminal] section is invalid. Omit the section when you do not want to manage any terminal settings.

Two different opacity settings#

background_opacity controls the terminal background. wallpaper.opacity controls how the image is mixed in. Configure them independently.

What stays unmanaged#

Omitted fields are unmanaged. Font family, keybindings, minimum contrast, and other Ghostty settings remain in your normal Ghostty configuration.

Ghostty Wall manages selected visual settings through its integration hook; it does not replace your entire Ghostty config.
